I run a fast-paced retail shop, and while Vyapar has a decent interface for basic accounting, it is incredibly frustrating to use at a busy billing counter. The software forces you to do too much manual clicking and has some serious automation flaws.

Embarrassing automated messages: The WhatsApp automation sends the invoice to the customer the second you click create—before you can mark the payment as received. So, a customer hands you cash, and they instantly get a message saying they have a "Balance Due." It makes customers think we are scamming them.

You can't use the keyboard for fast billing: If you type an item code, you can't just press 'Enter' to select it. You have to grab the mouse and click it from the drop-down. There is no keyboard shortcut to add the next item row either. It slows the line down terribly.
Weird customer name limits: You cannot add a customer if they have the same name as someone else in your system, even if their phone number is completely different. Very illogical.
Extra steps for UPI QR: You can’t just print a direct Sale Invoice with a UPI QR code on it. You have to make a Sale Order first, then convert it. Why?

Messy Inventory: The inventory management is outdated. It doesn't stop staff from creating duplicate items. If you try to delete the duplicate later, the system won't let you unless you go back and delete every single past transaction tied to it. There is no way to just "merge" them.
Currently, the available roles are limited and predefined. As a result, users do not have the flexibility to customize permissions according to their business needs.
